name: NC Custom Product Bundles for WooCommerce
author: nayden4o

sections.description:
NC Custom Product Bundles for WooCommerce lets you create simple product bundles with dynamic or fixed pricing. Perfect to sell sets, packs, or combinations of products.

  • Custom “Bundle” product type.
  • Optional (selectable) or fixed components.
  • Fixed price or sum of components.
  • Dynamic totals in cart.
  • Works with checkout and orders.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate it from Plugins → Installed Plugins.
  3. Create a new product and select Bundle as product type.
sections.faq:
Does it require WooCommerce?

Yes, WooCommerce must be installed and active.
